subject: Portal evidence delegation & temporary credential checklist
messages:
From: Tamara Simmons <tamara.simmons@vendorco.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: onetrust-onboarding@onetrust.com, security@acmeplc.com
Date: 2027-04-25T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: New portal onboarding + SIG/CAIQ scoping

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're ready to onboard VendorCo's profile to OneTrust so your security team can review the SIG/CAIQ and the supporting evidence. I attached the SIG template we usually use (SIG_questionnaire_2027.xlsx).

Two quick asks to make the import clean:
- Can you confirm who at Redwood will be the evidence owner(s) for: SIG responses, cloud system proofs (S3/KMS logs), and CAIQ mapping?
- We generally use ephemeral upload creds for initial bulk evidence — acceptable? If yes, what TTL would you prefer and who should receive them?

If helpful we can do a 20-min screenshare to walk through the portal import UI. Proposed window: Tue/Wed morning PST.

Att: SIG_questionnaire_2027.xlsx (Excel, 1 worksheet)

Best,
Tamara Simmons
Vendor Onboarding Lead | VendorCo
T: +1 415 555 0123

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Tamara Simmons <tamara.simmons@vendorco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, onetrust-onboarding@onetrust.com
Date: 2027-04-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New portal onboarding + SIG/CAIQ scoping

Tamara — thanks and welcome. We're ready to move forward. Quick ownership proposal so things don't bounce:
- SIG responses + follow-up Qs: Marissa Cole (evidence steward)
- Cloud/system proofs (S3/KMS/syslog attachments): Ben Carter (infrastructure proofs)
- CAIQ mapping and controls linkage: Karthik Iyer (controls owner)

Ephemeral upload creds are fine for the initial bulk ingest. Can we set TTL to 48 hours for uploads and share the creds with Ben and Marissa only? After upload we prefer evidence be staged in a signed manifest (CSV) and then the portal can pull the manifest.

I copied the team above. Marissa/Ben/Karthik — can you confirm you can accept ownership and that 48h TTL works? Also propose Wed 08:30–09:00 PT for a short handoff session with Onetrust.

Date: 2027-04-26T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New portal onboarding + SIG/CAIQ scoping

Jonas — I'm happy to take SIG ownership. Ben + I discussed storage locations and the easiest path:

Plan (high level):
- VendorCo uploads evidence bundle to the OneTrust staging bucket using ephemeral creds.
- VendorCo includes evidence_manifest.csv at root (filename + SHA256 + created_at + control_id mapping).
- Ben will validate presence of S3 object hashes against the manifest and confirm KMS key IDs in the metadata before release to the portal.

Attachments: evidence_manifest.csv (CSV, three columns: filename, sha256, control_id)

48h TTL is acceptable for the ingest window. Ben — can you stand up an accept-only S3 policy and share the ARN we should provide to VendorCo? Karthik — once imported we will need a brief CAIQ control-assignment pass to ensure mapping aligns with Redwood's control ids.

On Wed 08:30 PT I can run the portal walkthrough and prioritize the SIG sections that tend to cause follow-ups (access mgmt, key rotation, endpoint monitoring).

Marissa Cole
Security Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Tamara Simmons <tamara.simmons@vendorco.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: onetrust-onboarding@onetrust.com
Date: 2027-04-27T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New portal onboarding + SIG/CAIQ scoping

Perfect — thanks for the clear owners and the manifest format.

Next steps from VendorCo: 
1) I'll generate a 48-hour S3 upload token and post the link + instructions to the onboarding ticket: https://onetrust.example.com/portal/Request/12345
2) Please have Ben confirm the accept-only bucket ARN so I can restrict the token.
3) I'll complete the initial SIG import and flag controls that require trace artifacts (we'll include links to evidence files per the manifest).
4) We'll run the Wed 08:30 PT walkthrough and finalize CAIQ assignments.

Attachments included: portal_temp_creds_README.txt (plain text, short TTL and upload instructions)

Tamara Simmons
Vendor Onboarding Lead | VendorCo
